title: fynkel.AudioSource
description: A clip with its playback settings on the entity. `playing: true` in a scene starts the clip when the scene loads (like an `Animator`); the world clears it when a non-looping clip ends (`PLAYBACK_ENDED`). A behaviour drives it with the `Audio` command (`play`, `stop`, `pause`, `resume`, `setVolume`, `setPitch`) or by writing the component: a changed `volume`/`pitch`/`looping` reaches the playing voice at the next tick, a changed `playing` starts or stops it. The clip must be an audio source the world was given (`World::register_sound`; the loaders register every clip a loaded scene's sources name, `SOUND_UNAVAILABLE` once otherwise).

clip.description: The audio asset (a `.wav`/`.ogg` source; no sub-asset).

x-fynkel.tooltip: The bus this source plays through: master, music or sfx.

pitch.description: Playback rate multiplier, `MIN_PITCH..=MAX_PITCH`; `1` is the clip's own rate.

x-fynkel.tooltip: Playback rate; 1 is the clip's own rate.

playing.description: Whether the clip is playing (authored `true`: from the load).

priority.description: Who keeps a voice when the voice limit is reached: a new sound steals the voice of the lowest-priority sound at or below its own priority (the oldest among equals) and is refused when every voice outranks it.

x-fynkel.tooltip: Past the voice limit a new sound steals the lowest-priority voice at or below its own.
